svg.title: Tenohira Musei — The Voiceless Hand. Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Waxing Crescent forks into Unspoken Blow then Deafening Silence, or Held Breath then Tipping the Balance. Waning Crescent forks into Hushed Inferno then Eclipse in Hand, or Bared to the Moon then Stillness Breaks. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Yin-Yang-classified Tenohira Musei jutsu.

The bloodline's Defensive and Control traits live in unsupported rows (seal on Silent Palm Strike, buffprevent/debuffprevent on Eternal Stillness, move on Silent Rift), so potency reaches control only through Moonlit Inferno's two 35% enemy debuffs (Decrease Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken, all four stat types, 40 AP) and Cascade's 35% exposure. Breaks"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: root Yang (Waxing Crescent, +3 self Increase Damage Given on Rift and Cascade) forks into a Damage route (Unspoken Blow \u2192 Deafening Silence) and a self-buff route (Held Breath \u2192 Tipping the Balance). Root Yin (Waning Crescent, +2 exposure, +2 suppression) forks into a suppression route (Hushed Inferno \u2192 Eclipse in Hand) and an exposure route (Bared to the Moon \u2192 Stillness Breaks). 2/4/4 nodes; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP against the 4 BP cap.","Flats scaled by coverage. Damage reaches three 40-power rows, so it carries the reference ladder +2/+3 (max +5, 45 power). Increase Damage Given reaches two stacking self rows: +3/+2/+2 (max +7, 42% each); the Foundation is single-tag because it is the only broadly useful tag on that root. Increase Damage Taken reaches two stacking enemy rows: +2/+2/+3 (max +7, 42%), the two-row guardrail. Decrease Damage Given is one universal row: the single-row ladder +2/+3/+5 (max +10, 45%).","Capstone secondaries cross roots so no capstone out-bids a sibling Hidden Art on its own tag: Tipping the Balance adds +2 suppression, Eclipse in Hand +2 self buff, Stillness Breaks +2 Damage; Deafening Silence is single-tag like Solar Cataclysm. Row-weighted node values: Foundations 6/6, Hidden Arts 6/4/3/4, Advanced Arts 9/6/9/12; full builds 19\u201328 (Taiyo Kami 20\u201331 on nine rows). Maxima over all legal builds: Damage +5, IDG +7, IDT +7, DDG +10; not jointly attainable.","Main tree, passives, pierce: both self Increase Damage Given rows are element-less or list None, so at the pin (getEfficiencyRatio, SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73) they multiply the kit's own Yin-Yang hits, basic attacks and non-elemental normal jutsu in their windows; the 25% + 0.15/level Increase Damage Given passive stacks on top as a bloodline-sourced modifier. Moonlit Inferno's debuffs list all four stat types, no element: every non-pierce source. No node touches pierce, seal, prevention or move.","Delivery and uptime: every cast is cooldown 7; every percentage row lasts 2 rounds. Rift, Cascade and Palm Strike cost 60 AP; Moonlit Inferno 40 AP, range 4. Silent Rift's Damage is a ground circle (range 5, enemies only); its self buff is a SELF row on that spawn and, per the batch-1 ground-circle lesson (move sorts last), reaches the caster from the next round while in the circle. Stacked figures (84% self buff, 84% exposure) need two overlapping casts for 100\u2013120 AP: ceilings, not rotations.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Waning Crescent or Held Breath; Amplifier Waning Crescent or Unspoken Blow; Suppression Waxing Crescent or Bared to the Moon; Exposure Hushed Inferno or Waxing Crescent. Of 14 legal full allocations, 12 are non-dominated and every node appears in one. The dominated pair are no-capstone hybrids: 01+02+06+09 (beaten by 01+06+09+10) and 01+04+06+07 (beaten by 01+06+07+08). Accepted: a four-tag kit cannot put capstone secondaries on tags no Hidden Art carries."],"risks":["Self-buff leakage: neither Increase Damage Given row has a binding stat filter at the pin (Rift: Highest, no element; Cascade: Fire/Lightning/Yin-Yang/None), so the +7 route raises every matching normal jutsu, weapon and basic attack in its two-round window, not only bloodline casts. Overlapping windows stack to 84% over the 25% + 0.15/level passive (tag stacking on). Uptime not simulated.","Exposure stacking: Moonlit Inferno's Increase Damage Taken (all four stat types, no element) and Cascade's (Highest, no element) are separate two-round debuffs that stack on one target to 70% base and 84% at the +7 route maximum, amplifying hits from the player, allies and weapons. Pierce hits are unaffected (modifiers run before pierce). Flats were held to the two-row guardrail for this reason.","Suppression concentration: Decrease Damage Given has one row (Moonlit Inferno, 40 AP, range 4, 2 rounds) and the route takes it to 45%; its whole value rides one single-target cast per seven rounds, and it does not reduce enemy pierce. Moonlit Inferno is the kit's only cast that this tree makes defensive.","Silent Rift delivery: its Increase Damage Given row is a SELF row on an EMPTY_GROUND AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN jutsu. The dossier marks it a self buff; the batch-1 lesson says it reaches the caster from the following round while standing in the circle (move sorts last). SELF-row handling on ground spawns was not separately source-verified. Its Damage row is friendly-fire ENEMIES; no ally-hazard row exists.","Classification: Yin-Yang is the signature element on all three Damage rows but eight census bloodlines share it (Ethereal Monarch and Heavenly Sonata are INCLUDE; six DEFER/EXCLUDE), so the label works only as a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification, not a bare element match. Under the current resolver 4 of 8 supported rows fall back to None. Normal-jutsu collision is unverified.","Unsupported control: seal (Silent Palm Strike), buffprevent/debuffprevent (Eternal Stillness) and move (Silent Rift) receive nothing, so the bloodline's Defensive and Control traits are not strengthened by any route; the tree makes an A-rank control kit hit harder and debuff harder, which may read as off-trait to the user. Eternal Stillness is untouched by every build.","Dominance: 12 of 14 full builds are numerically non-dominated; the two dominated no-capstone hybrids are named in design_notes and accepted. The dominance count treats every tag as a gain and ignores delivery, so it is structural evidence only.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is not approved, so a combined stacking audit is required before implementation; Yin-Yang Cascade (3 supported rows) is touched by every route, making it the kit's load-bearing cast. No combat simulation was performed; balance values remain user-owned."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":12,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":7},"supported_rows_in_kit":8,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Tenohira Musei jutsu inherit Yin-Yang potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. g.text: Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Tenohira Musei jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Tipping the Balance path + Waning Crescent
Eclipse in Hand path + Waxing Crescent
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
